convert the tabular information from a ggiResource instance into GRanges

Source: R/toGRanges.R
toGRanges.Rd

convert the tabular information from a ggiResource instance into GRanges

Usage

toGRanges(tbl, genome = NA, maxn.msg = 50000)

Arguments

tbl

resource with seqnames, start, end

genome

character(1) should come from resource 'space' element

maxn.msg

numeric(1) if number of records for conversion to GRanges exceeds this, a message is given
